sentence: This project studies how a complement protein in the lung helps kill bacteria and protect against pneumonia.
This project uses robotics and neuromuscular modeling to fit gait rehabilitation to each patient after a stroke.
This project uses medical imaging to find osteonecrosis of the femoral head earlier and predict how patients will do.
This project uses a bioluminescent sensor and CRISPR knockout screens to find genes that control cellular adhesion.
This project builds a non-invasive MRI method with an oxidatively activated probe to detect intestinal inflammation in animal models.
This project builds bioinformatics pipelines to test whether laboratory models match Alzheimer's disease in patients.
This project studies how a factor that suppresses double-stranded RNAs in cancer cells works, and whether blocking it helps immunotherapy in small cell lung cancer.
This project builds an off-the-shelf T cell product to treat patients whose B cell cancer resists treatment or comes back.
This project builds nanocapsules that carry antibodies against HIV into the central nervous system of infants.
This project makes T cells, changed with a gene, better at killing T cell lymphoma, and prepares versions made from healthy people in advance.
This project builds a system that uses natural language processing on emergency department data to track injuries in children.
This project studies how glioblastoma and overactive networks of neurons affect each other, using a mouse tumor model.
This project uses noninvasive coronary computed tomographic angiography to study plaques in women and minorities with coronary artery disease.
This project uses RNA sequencing methods to learn how ribothrypsis breaks down mRNA.
This project studies how a transcription factor sets the position and connections of starburst amacrine cells in the retina.
This project builds statistical and machine learning methods to work out which cell types are present in tissue, using spatial transcriptomics data.
This project studies how B cells inside pancreatic tumors make antibodies that change the tumor microenvironment after immunotherapy.
This project uses protoacoustic and ultrasound imaging to map the Bragg peak in 3D during proton therapy.
This project uses computational imaging to predict which patients with acute severe ulcerative colitis need surgery and to study genetic causes.
This project builds statistical methods and software for microbiome data to study how the microbiome relates to disease.
